answers.core: I think at least documentation on this should be included within Godot's official documentation, even if any implementation is outside of the main source code. The reason for this is to avoid confusion by providing **a singular official way for running c# unittests**.
answers.workaround: Not that I am aware of.

title: Add or document a way to write unit tests for Godot C# projects (e.g. with nunit3)
